procedure.name: audit-tag-ids
procedure.step: Scan all tags in the template
For each tag missing an id attribute, generate a semantic suggestion based on context/content
Present the full list of suggestions to the user for approval

procedure.name: wrap-emoji
procedure.step: Find all raw emoji characters in template text
Look up the Unicode character name for each emoji

procedure.name: convert-repetitive-tags
procedure.step: Identify 3+ sibling tags with identical structure but different data
Extract the varying data into an array

procedure.name: wrap-bare-text
procedure.step: Search for text nodes that are direct children of block-level containers
Propose wrapping each in a <span> tag
Ask user which cases to apply
